# M0-S7: --pedantic is a logos-only build flag: accepted by logos build,
# silent when false, standard parse error for bad values, unknown under
# plain go, and documented in logos help build.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# logos build accepts --pedantic and the resulting binary runs.
logos build --pedantic -o $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE .
exists $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE
exec $WORK/bin/ped$GOEXE
stdout '^hello$'

# --pedantic=false stays silent at the flag layer.
logos build --pedantic=false .
! stdout 'pedantic'
! stderr 'pedantic'

# An invalid value fails with the standard flag parse error.
! logos build --pedantic=maybe .
stderr '^invalid boolean value "maybe" for -pedantic'

# Plain go keeps the upstream unknown-flag error: the flag is logos-only.
! go build --pedantic .
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -pedantic'

# logos help build documents the flag.
logos help build
stdout 'pedantic'

# Plain go help stays upstream and names no logos-only flag.
go help build
! stdout 'pedantic'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/pedantic

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
